timeline.x: [Press Release] HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 03, 2026, relating to Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results and other matters relating to capacity expansion of Anode plant, setting up of new businesses and ESOP scheme".

[Press Release] HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 03, 2026, relating to Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results and other matters relating to capacity expansion of Anode plant and setting up of new businesses.".

[Updates] HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Communication by HEG Graphite Limited (renamed as HEG Limited), Resulting Company (as per Composite Scheme of Arrangement) regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026'.

[Updates] HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation by Resulting Company (As per Composite Scheme of Arrangement) regarding dropping of proceedings by GST Authority for FY 2020-21'.
[Updates] HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Change in name of HEG Graphite Limited (Resulting Company as per Composite Scheme of Arrangement) to HEG Limited'.

[Press Release] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 25, 2026, titled "HEG Demerger to Take Effect from September 1, 2026; Record Date Fixed for September 7, 2026; and Changes in leadership pursuant to the Scheme becoming effective from September 1,  2026".

[Change in Management] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about Cessation of Senior Management Personnel of the Company consequent upon transfer of their employment to HEG Graphite Limited pursuant to the effectiveness of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement w.e.f September 1, 2026.

[General Updates] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about Relinquishment of Shri Ravi Jhunjhunwala from the office of Chairman, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer and Key Managerial Personnel pursuant to the effectiveness of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement i.e. September 1, 2026 and continue as the NonExecutive Non Independent Director of the Company, liable to retire by rotation.

[Outcome of Board Meeting] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 24, 2026 related to Effective Date of Scheme, Record Date for Scheme, Reconstitution of Committees,  Noting of Certified Copy of Hon'ble NCLT Order for Composite Scheme of Arrangement etc.
[Press Release] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 19, 2026, titled "NCLT Order sanctioning the Composite Scheme of Arrangement".

[General Updates] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of the Order passed by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Indore Bench ( Tribunal ), sanctioning the Composite Scheme of Arrangement.

[Scheme of Arrangement] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of the Order passed by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Indore Bench ( Tribunal ), sanctioning the Composite Scheme of Arrangement amongst HEG Limited ( Company  or  Demerged Company  or  Transferee Company ), HEG Graphite Limited ( Resulting Company ) and Bhilwara Energy Limited ( Transferor Company ) and their respective shareholders and creditors under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 ( Scheme ).

[General Updates] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation to physical shareholder- Important Action Required- Update KYC Details and Dematerialize your Shares of HEG Limited Before the Record Date for Allotment of Equity Shares of HEG Graphite Limited pursuant to the Composite Scheme of Arrangement

[Press Release] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Press Release being issued by the Company in relation to its Q1 FY27financial results and update on the Composite Scheme of Arrangement.".
[General Updates] HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Composite Scheme of Arrangement.
